title: trigonotis radicans subsp. sericea
intro: Trigonotis radicans subsp. sericea, commonly known as silky trigonotis, is a species of flowering plant in the borage family that is native to China. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of silky trigonotis include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of silky trigonotis include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential anti-cancer and anti-inflammatory activities.
